profile.name: Newport XPS运动控制器
profile.description: 用于通过 TCP/IP 控制 Newport XPS 多轴运动控制器的功能接口，可完成运动组初始化、回零、绝对/相对运动、轨迹执行、编码器与伺服参数配置、GPIO 触发、事件联动和数据采集，常用于精密位移台与多轴定位系统。
profile.description_en: Functional interface for a Newport XPS multi-axis motion controller over TCP/IP. It supports group initialization, homing, absolute and relative moves, trajectory execution, encoder and servo parameter configuration, GPIO triggering, event handling, and data gathering for precision stages and multi-axis positioning systems.
